name: 💪 Iron & Protein Oatmeal Bowls
what: Oats cooked in milk, peanut butter stirred in, cold yogurt and fruit on top.

core.name: Milk
core.out: water, then a splash of milk at the end

core.name: Greek yogurt
core.out: skip it, or add an extra spoon of peanut butter

extras: bananas, blueberries, pumpkin seeds, honey, cinnamon

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Warm 3 cups milk with a pinch of salt in a pot until it just bubbles.
Stir in 2 cups oats. Cook on medium-low, stirring now and then.
Off the heat, stir in the peanut butter.
Into bowls, a big spoon of cold yogurt on top, then any fruit we have.

key: Cook the oats in milk, not water, and add the yogurt cold on top.
done: Thick and creamy, and a spoon leaves a trail.
plan_b: No oats? Yogurt bowls: yogurt, peanut butter, fruit and granola.
